Chem 1251 is really not an easy course but he makes it bearable. Does a lot of practice problems during lectures which was helpful. He is really engaging during lectures and really does want you to succeed. Use his office hours they helped me turn my grade around from failing. Just put in the work and you'll succeed in the class. He's a great guy.

#1 OG. Top Dawg.

Very knowledgeable and engaging with students. It's a tough class but as long as you're actively participating Dr. Slowey does the absolute best to help you understand something. So ask questions. Try to keep the same energy because it makes the lectures so much better. Overall definitely one of my favorite professors of all time
Dr Slowey is knowledgeable and explains concepts clearly. He uses examples during lectures. Exams are challenging. Practice tests are provided. He is approachable and office hours are useful.

Good professor, he is clearly VERY passionate about chemistry.

He goes through material very quickly but takes questions before moving on during lectures. Content builds off of previous units in this course so do not get behind. Just study and attend office hours outside of class if you don't understand something and you will be fine.

Funniest and chilliest chemistry professor I have ever had. Goes through lectures quick but provides a lot of opportunity to do practice problems and ask questions. It is important that you go to class with at least a preview of the textbook, so you're not totally lost in class. Practice problems are harder than the actual exams. Easy pass :)

Dr. Slowey is a good professor.  He demonstrated some growing pains like errors to problem solutions, but I wouldn't expect to see this next semester, as this was his first at UNCC.  It is of note that he gives relatable examples and of all the professors I've had, he is by far one of the most approachable, easiest to access, and willing to help.

He is one of the best professors I've had here! He makes the course more enjoyable with his sense of humor, and also shows genuine care for his students by walking around and helping us individually with exam-type questions. Highly recommend skimming through and looking at the content beforehand to get an idea of what will be covered. Study though!

Dr Slowey is an amazing professor! He really cares about his students and is very easy to access outside of class. Office hours were very helpful and practice exams helped prepare for the exams very well.

Compared to other chemistry professors, I will say he's been a better addition to the department. The chem department at UNC Charlotte sucks, but he's made this class bearable. He's basically a theatre kid, and that somehow made this class seem a little more interesting. The class is still hard, so make sure to actually study or else you'll fail.

Awesome guy—funny, clear, and fair. He explains topics well and expects you to study on your own, which is normal for college. Not an easy course, of course, but he gives you everything you need to succeed. Weekly homework, Poll Everywhere for attendance, 4 exams, and a final. Definitely recommend!

He definitely makes this course more enjoyable. Lectures go fast so definitely ask questions. Go to office hours and get tutoring early on. Make sure you complete the Aleks pie for extra points on your final. And go to class everyday he uses poll everywhere. If you feel lost from the beginning and feel too overwhelmed try parachuting to chem 1200.

He spoke to us as if we were scientists and not students trying to learn college-level chemistry. When asking him a question, he would not be very helpful and would make me question my ability. His lectures go by way too fast, often expecting students to just magically understand the material. You have to teach yourself the material again when you go home. Tests are so wildly different from the test reviews as well.

One of the best chemistry teachers I've ever had. Honestly anyone could get an A in the class but it's just about dedicating time to study every day and making sure you understand the concepts before the tests. The class itself has a lot of content so if you study last minute you won't do well.

Dr. Slowey is def a good CHEM 1251 professor. He goes through the content very quickly, so if you feel confused about the content, his office hours definitely help clarify information. While CHEM 1251 is already a hard class itself Dr.Slowey makes it more bearable. He explains terms in an easier way to comprehend and shows examples such as him carrying a chair up the stairs. Dr. Fessler was a great professor and fair grader. His class is based on 10 quizzes and 3 exams and a final. He provided 3 extra 8 points each and practice problems. The course is based on just quiz and test grades both of which are made up of very few questions that were often about very random things discussed in the course. Not nearly enough practice problems were given. Smart guy but doesnt teach in a way that is easily understandable to someone taking the course for the first time.

Professlor is an extremely knowledgeable guy about organic chemistry, but he is not effective at teaching students who do not have as deep of an understanding of chemistry as him. This course is entirely based on quizzes and test (the extra credit is mandatory if you want to pass). Would recommend staying away unless you have a PhD understanding.

Dr. Fessler ran this class exactly how Dr. Walter would. I do believe Dr. Fessler is a good professor. However, if you are a bio major I would stay away from him. The WORST professor for an upper chemistry class! Does not know how to condense the information and explain it in detail. One of the worst professors I've ever had. Grades strictly, reads from slides, gives really no help and excepts you to just kind of understand what he is teaching. As intelligent as he is, he absolutely cannot teach, prepare to teach yourself. I was an honor student before enrolling in this class as a chem major; my first mistake was relying on his lectures. Dr. Fessler really explains the labs before you start, has very clear grading criteria, gives really great feedback on the completed labs, helps during class, responds promptly to emails, is brutally honest with the best intentions and is silly to make class fun. Great professor, engaging lectures, at times might be confusing, but very down to earth professor! would take class with her again

Intro to chem. She is very nice and lets you retake the first 3 exams, they aren't too hard. This is an introductory chem classes and she teaches it like an introductory chem class. Professor Kant is a very clear and organized instructor. Her assignments were fairly simple, and she thoroughly explains well during her lectures and such. super laid-back and sweet. I went to her office hours and emailed back and forth a few times she's really nice and accommodating if you build a relationship with her. I've heard from most of my class that it's their hardest class but if you pay attention during lectures she does a great job explaining and it was one of my favorite classes!

This is quite literally the most ridiculous class I have ever taken. ZERO point in the difficulty level, much less for a 1 credit hour class. Not the best in terms of actually teaching the material well. No one can keep up with a 90 minute lecture with non stop talking.

Do not take. I love a hard test but his were straight up unfair. His lectures are slow and uninteresting, and he holds his students to a standard that I doubt any in his class met. The most ridiculous one credit course I have ever taken. With the amount of work that was assigned it should have been a three credit course. Extremely disrespectful of our time to give us so much work in such a silly, low level class. Awful class.

If you are at risk of experiencing any issues during the semester DO NOT TAKE THIS CLASS. Strict grading heavily based on reading quizzes and two group projects. He asked me to submit documentation, then declined it. Only thing that saves this class is what TA you get.

TA saved class, literally. Horrible formatting of the class (tests every week, 2 hours worth of reading, supplemental videos), the lab structure had NOTHING to do with the lecture portion. I do not recomend taking this course with Dr. Cao. He is not understanding at all of outside circumstances such as car trouble , surgery, submission issues. Genuinely my favorite biology course I've taken. Though the exams could be difficult, I believe that they were graded fairly and the questions directly reflected concepts we spoke of in class. I took Dr. Cao's summer evolution class and I enjoyed it overall. He tries to make his class engaging and I learned a lot from his class. 4 labs, 2 projects. This lab was tough b/c of the quizzes and his grading. It depends on the TA you get--I'd recommend taking it with Vedika. Don't miss class because Dr. Cao is not very understanding and won't let you make up the quizzes/labs.

Dr. Cao is the lab coordinator for 2130 and has the 1 credit hour course set up where you are working 5-20 hours a week on getting everything done in lab, studying for weekly tests given out before lab, and working on ridiculously detailed projects including an hour long debate with a 5 page 11 point font paper. Honestly I loved Dr. S and her class. She is easy to understand and teaches very good. I would recommend to anyone who takes bio 1101. Also her TA was amazing and helpful!

Dr. S is a great teacher who genuinely wants her students to succeed. Anatomy is a hard class but her class is doable. This course is very easy; I took it to fulfill a gen ed requirement. Class is structured w lecture and then class activity. Not a lot of work load at all. Just study the notes and you will be fine on tests. And Dr. S is very sweet! Not a bio major but if I were, I would take classes w her.

Her accent is very heavy... almost to the point where it's hard to pay attention to her lectures. Her exams are very difficult. I went to class almost every day and still ended up with a C. Meh professor.

Dr. Somayaji is an amazing professor! She is knowledgeable and passionate about her field of study and does what she can to help students learn and become better students. Class was an easy A. Dr.S is amazing! She is so kind and understanding, she genuinely cares for her students. Lectures are long, but they're very detailed and she is clear about what's going to be tested. You can tell she's passionate about the subject and actually wants us to learn. Very encouraging and easy to understand during lectures. Would definitely recommend to all of my friends.

Took this class in Fall 2024. Exams are challenging, but if you study the powerpoint slides and follow the note outlines you'll be fine. She is not polite and caring. and doesn't let us to ask the questions in the class.

She's friendly and approachable, but not an effective teacher. The course relied heavily on lectures, and the exams were based on her PowerPoint presentations. The chapter outlined notes she provided were essential for my success.

Take her class if you're a good tester. Outside of this class she is an incredible resource and person, and she's incredibly kind. Don't worry, Bullock's inability to concisely summarize material in lectures is coupled with her insanely detailed and nightmare inducing exams. This would be less annoying if her exams were based on the textbook, but they're not- and they're also nothing like the homework assignments. Avoid.

very passionate teacher, but tests are very tricky like they're made for you to fail, with very small and sometimes irrelevant details posing as questions. you need to absorb everything in the textbook and her slides to get an A in her class. i wouldn't recommend taking any other difficult classes if you are taking this class with her.

I really liked MRS. BULLOCK she did tell you extra things to know for exams. But it just seems like the exams were set up to trick you with 50 questions. The professor is pretty average. Lectures are prerecorded online. If you want to get an A in this class over the summer it has to be your LIFE. I took this prof. Summer one online cell biology class.

Tests are pretty difficult, 50 questions with lockdown browser.
DO NOT TAKE IN THE SUMMER. Does not drop exams and its a lot of information to take in for the weekly exams. Study guide is not much help either.

Dr. Bullock's class wasn't terrible, but it wasn't great either. There was a lot of busy work that was time-consuming and her lectures were dry and boring. Nicest professor but she cannot teach. Her lectures are boring and she talks way too much. Not very engaging and will watch over your shoulder at notes. Dr. Bullock is AWESOME!!! I would recommend taking her for any class you can. She knows so much and does an amazing job at explaining things. She also really cares about her students and really works to get to know you. She's one of the best professors I've ever had.
It is clear that Dr. Bullock loves cell biology and loves teaching it.  She is a wonderful lecturer and I really enjoyed her class.

I enjoyed Dr. Bullock's class this summer. I am not a Biology major so some of the topics were a little confusing for me but if you study the PowerPoints you should be fine. The class was pretty easy to understand and grasp if you come to lectures and do the post lecture work. Assignments that weren't exams were commonly graded for completion. Having a professor that enjoys their job makes a difference. This was one of the easiest science classes I have taken here. Dr. Wells is a lovely professor! She's very accessible and responds to emails so fast with good feedback. This professor honestly isn't very good. She often makes mistakes using technology (in an online class) and I just didn't get much out of the two courses I took with her. If you have a genuine interest in learning biology then I would take another professor's class.

Dr. Wells is a fantastic professor. Come to class prepared each day having done your reading and assignments and you'll do great in her courses. She is passionate about conservation and is a great biologist. Highly recommend her classes.

Semester-long group project but its chunked out so not that bad. Grading on it is insane though with unhelpful rubric. Classwork was minimal and easy. Ever heard of the song Work by Rihanna? Well you better get ready to "work work work work work" because this class is slammed with busy work. Very kind professor but just an insane amount of work each week. Need to be able to know how to record a podcast to pass...

Exams aren't hard if you do the study guides. Lecture notes have great visuals and are easy to follow. The projects are an easy A if you put solid work into it. She is super easy to reach via email and is so easy to work with- she will accommodate you and do her best to help you do your best. Can't wait to take her again for conservation bio!

This was a poorly managed course with a grading metric that the professor refused to define. Decent teacher and she teaches decent subjects, but her grading is insane. The course pacing is the worst and her online exams are on Friday when due midnight when you literarily have other classes.

Dr. Wells is a real nice lady. The class isn't particularly difficult as it's most of the stuff you've learned earlier in life. The exams used lockdown browser with the camera but weren't hard. BIO 3144 with Professor Prosser had interesting content, but communication was slow, and grading felt inconsistent. Exams were tough, but the TA's review sessions helped. Dr. Wells is 10/10. She comments back on all student assignments. Organized canvas page, quick grader, fast email responces.
Nice person but Disorganized asl when it comes to being a professor. takes random points off.

Not understanding gives no grace to students. It doesn't take much to be understanding and personable. But she ain't got that

Mrs. Harris was so kind and made us feel cared for. So unhelpful. I asked for help and all I got was "are you studying?"

Professor Harris was very kind. Mrs. Harris was a very good professor. This was a hard class when taking it, but she gives you chapter outlines to use for notes. she is such a great professor, ATTEND the review sessions she would legit tell us what was on the test, she is very sweet and explains stuff really well. the test are case studies, but she gives you so much resources to practice, study and you'll do perfectly fine in this class

Mrs. Harris is very nice. Her lectures can be a bit boring at times, but if you go you'll definitely get something out of it. The first two exams were easy and then the last two were harder. The third one in particular was really hard. Study and you'll do fine!

The class is textbook and lecture-heavy but she provides the PowerPoints and a reading guide so it is very clear what she expects you to remember for the tests. Biology 1 - Overall a solid professor, the work stays consistent with pre-class activities and chapter quizzes that happen every week, no pop quizzes, very nice professor, her tests are pretty hard and make you study a lot of the minor details. Amazing lecturer and gives activities in class to understand the material. A lot of homework tho, but honestly it helps your grade. Attendance was mandatory but you can miss 3 days. Dr. Wisner was an amazing professor! I loved going to her lectures, and she made the info really easy to understand. There are pollev questions in every class. The exams were not terrible, the final exam is optional if you're happy with your grade. I would def take her again!!

She is great. Just finished a summer course with her and it was amazing. Easy class and she was the best. Gives fun projects, interests you in her class. She really loves what she teaches and it shows. Overall, great professor. Would take again.
